consequence.statement: An environment relying on a single IPsec key (with the '+' sign in the secret) no longer has that configuration honoured: per-tunnel keys are used regardless of the '+' sign, so the key material in the secret must be provided as per-tunnel keys.
consequence.remediation: Update the IPsec key material to per-tunnel keys; the '+' sign in the secret no longer selects single-key behaviour.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17 removes support for a single IPsec key: per-tunnel keys are now used regardless of the presence of the '+' sign in the secret, so the single-key configuration is no longer honoured.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence says the change is keyed on 'the presence of the + sign in the secret' but never names the IPsec secret (or a values key / cilium-config key / flag that enables single-key IPsec), and the listed config sources do not cover the IPsec key secret, so no predicate can be written without inventing identifiers.
